user.title: Set up PowerView Home
user.description: Configure your PowerView encryption key. All shades on your network will be discovered automatically via Bluetooth.

data_description.hub_url: Base URL of your PowerView G3 hub, e.g. {hub_url_example}. Leave empty if you do not have one.

zeroconf_confirm.title: PowerView gateway discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description: A PowerView G3 gateway was found at {name}. Choose how to configure your encryption key — fetch it automatically from the gateway, enter it manually, or skip. All shades on your network will be discovered automatically via Bluetooth.

data_description.hub_url: Base URL of your PowerView G3 hub, e.g. {hub_url_example}. Leave empty if you do not have one.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure PowerView Home
reconfigure.description: Change the encryption key or the hub URL. Shades stay where they are and keep their settings. An encrypted shade shows no controls at all until a valid key is configured. Clear the hub URL if you no longer have a PowerView G3 hub.

data_description.hub_url: Base URL of your PowerView G3 hub, e.g. {hub_url_example}. Leave empty if you do not have one.

error.invalid_key_format: HomeKey must be a valid hexadecimal string
error.invalid_key_length: HomeKey must be exactly 32 hex characters (16 bytes)
error.hub_connection_error: Cannot connect to the PowerView hub
error.hub_url_required: Enter the hub URL, or choose another key source if you do not have a hub

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.
